text:
incident-bot: [AUTO] Incident RWINF-5043 resolved at 2026-03-14T23:06:12Z. Pager handoff: Taylor -> Mia. Impact: transient 5xx spikes to Redwood-API in us-west-2, estimated affected requests ~1.8% over 12m. Documentation: https://redwood.internal/incidents/RWINF-5043

Mia (SRE): Thanks for the quick triage everyone. We should schedule the postmortem this week. Proposing two short options to keep it focused:
• Wed 2026-03-17 16:00 PST / 19:00 EST
• Thu 2026-03-18 10:00 PDT / 13:00 EDT (good for EMEA too)
If you can attend, react with :thumbsup: on the option you prefer. If neither works, drop your availability here. We also need a facilitator for the write-up and the meeting — volunteers?

Sam (Eng PM): I can co-facilitate the meeting if needed. Will handle the timeline capture and action item tracking during the call.

Jordan (Product): I can do the customer-impact summary and help prioritize follow-ups — will need Deb's confirmation on affected customers.

Deb (Customer Success): I already have a customer impact sketch: two SMB customers saw elevated error rates and one enterprise account filed a support ticket. I can bring exact SLA and ticket numbers to the meeting.

Ravi (Infra): I'm +1 for Thu morning. I can bring the infra-level traces and the node-level metrics. Also we should decide whether to keep the temporary throughput cap we applied during mitigation.

Taylor (SRE): Thanks. Quick note: pager handoff log is attached to the incident, but we should call out that the mitigation was a config rollback to v2.3.1 which reduced load on the failing path. I can own the mitigation TL;DR in the write-up.

Mia (SRE): Agenda suggestion — please add anything else:
1) 5m — quick summary & timeline (owner: Sam)
2) 10m — technical root-cause & mitigation (owner: Taylor + Ravi)
3) 10m — customer impact & comms (owner: Deb + Jordan)
4) 10m — action items, owners, and SLO QA (facilitator: ???)
5) 5m — next steps and follow-up cadence

Sam (Eng PM): I'll draft the agenda in the incident doc. Can someone volunteer to facilitate the meeting itself? Facilitator duties: keep time, elicit RCA, confirm action owners, and create calendar invite. Ideally someone who wasnt deep in the debugging to stay neutral.

Jordan (Product): If no one else, I can facilitate — I'm fairly neutral here. But I'd prefer co-facilitation with Sam for timeline accuracy.

Mia (SRE): @Jordan and @Sam pairing works for me. Any objections?

Ravi (Infra): No objection. Quick ask: can the facilitator ensure we capture repro steps and any risky rollouts still in flight? I can add those to the doc but need someone to call them out in the meeting.

Deb (Customer Success): If Jordan facilitates, can they also confirm whether we need a targeted customer outreach? I have a draft message but want product sign-off.

Taylor (SRE): One more logistics item — timezone check. Jordan is Europe-shifted tomorrow; if we pick Thu 10:00 PDT that should still work. Also we need a Zoom link and calendar invite with a short pre-read pinned.

Mia (SRE): Ok plan: Jordan + Sam co-facilitate on Thu 2026-03-18 10:00 PDT. Jordan can create the calendar invite and ping the infra and cs leads. I'll mark the incident doc with the meeting time and add required pre-read items.

Jordan (Product): Creating invite now. Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/999999999 (placeholder). Calendar invite will include: incident doc, pre-read (timeline + logs excerpt + customer impact), and action-item template. Please add items to the doc by EOD Wed so I can circulate.

Sam (Eng PM): Adding timeline skeleton and a section for 'open questions' that we should answer in the meeting. Also creating an action-item tracker table in the doc.

Ravi (Infra): I'll drop a short excerpt of the node error logs and the curl command we used to repro the failing endpoint. Paste for pre-read:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?model=rw-small" | jq .error
# Node logs: /var/log/redwood/worker-42/error.log | tail -n 200
```

Deb (Customer Success): I'll add the ticket numbers and the list of customers impacted. Also will prepare a recommended comms blurb for support to use.

Taylor (SRE): I'll write a short mitigation timeline and include the config diff (rollback) in the doc. One thing for the meeting: decide whether to add an automated canary check on that path. I think that's a low-effort high-value follow-up.

Mia (SRE): Action items (capture for now; owners can refine):
• Draft postmortem write-up (owner: Sam)
• Facilitate meeting and timekeeper (owners: Jordan + Sam)
• Mitigation timeline + config diff (owner: Taylor)
• Infra logs & repro steps (owner: Ravi)
• Customer impact & comms draft (owner: Deb)
• Decide on canary / monitoring addition (owner: TBD)

Sam (Eng PM): I'll create those as tasks in the doc and ping owners. Let's aim to publish an initial postmortem draft within 48 hours of the mtg. Finalize within one week with action owners assigned.

Jordan (Product): If anyone can't make Thu, please mark your availability and either join via recording or leave a delegate. We will record the meeting.

Mia (SRE): One final: can the incident channel please react with :eyes: once you've put your pre-read items in the doc? That'll help us ensure prep coverage.

Deb (Customer Success): Marking done once I push the ticket list. :wave:

Taylor (SRE): :thumbsup:

Ravi (Infra): :thumbsup:

Sam (Eng PM): I'll follow up on calendar invite and ownerships. Thanks team.
